reviews.comment: If you learn by teachers just writing the answers and steps on the board for every question, you'll love her. Good class but not very engaging teaching methods

I honestly don't understand why some students don't like professor Booton. She may not be extremely social but as long as you follow along in the class and do the homework as you're supposed to, you will have no problem getting an A. Also, as long as you can do the practice exam, you will ace the real one which is significantly easier.

Don't listen to the 5 star reviews. They're all written in the middle of the semester, and three of them literally on the same day in the middle of November, a day before her super hard exam she taught us nothing about. Just puts the problems on the board, answers them, and moves on. Doesn't teach, even when asked questions. Don't take her.

I could tell off the bat that this professor cared a lot about her students. Her office hours are extremely helpful and help make the class much more manageable. It's very doable to score a high A in this class, just attend lectures and practice the problems she gives out. There is a textbook but its not very helpful.

This class was very easy with this professor. I skipped class a lot of times and still ended up getting an A since the tests were super easy and just like the practice test she gives. As long as you attend class you are good and should easily get a good grade. Really nice prof! Definitely recommend taking her.

First off, this professor knows their stuff inside out and somehow manages to make calculus totally make sense. The office hours were game changers for me and all the in class practice made it impossible to fail a test. I know calculus is hard for most people, but she made it surprisingly easy. Easiest calculus class at this university for sure.

Professor Laura Booton is a very good professor! She spends so much time making sure everyone understands how to do problems and explains concepts very well. It is almost impossible to do bad on an exam as long as you attend class with all the practice she does. The tests are very easy and around 15 questions. Just a great person overall!

Professor Booton has been extremely helpful for me, calc and math in general has never been an easy concept for me, however, she made it very enjoyable and explained things to a degree that actually made sense. She gives weekly quizzes but they are very easy to complete compared to other professor's assignment. Overall a very good lecturer as well.

Professor Booton is a very good prof. She knows how to explain concepts very well and makes sure everyone in the class is well prepared for quizzes and exams. The quizzes are basically free hundreds if you put minimal effort. Test are very easy as well and the class overall has very minimal workload.
Does not teach at all, just writes questions on the board and then circles the answer and moves on.
